pages.title: Home
pages.seoTitle: Ghumti Café, Jhamsikhel: momo, pour-over coffee and chiya
pages.seoDescription: A café in Jhamsikhel, Lalitpur. Hand-folded momo, coffee from Nuwakot and Gulmi roasted in-house, Thakali set on Saturdays. Open 7:30 to 21:00.

props.title: Slow coffee, buff momo and a long table by the window
props.text: We roast Nuwakot and Gulmi beans on Tuesdays, fold momo by hand every morning, and keep the chiya coming until the last guest leaves.

image.alt: The café's main room with long tables and hanging lamps

items.title: Hand-folded momo
items.text: Buff, chicken or mushroom and cheese. Steamed, jhol or kothey, folded fresh from six in the morning.

items.title: Single-origin pour-over
items.text: Beans from cooperatives in Nuwakot and Gulmi, roasted here in twelve-kilo batches.

items.title: Thakali set, Saturdays only
items.text: Rice, black dal, gundruk, saag, timur achar and chicken or mutton curry, refilled until you stop us.

items.title: Masala chiya all day
items.text: Boiled with fresh ginger, cardamom and a little black pepper. The first cup at 7:30 is on the house on Sundays.

image.alt: Coffee being poured over a paper filter

props.heading: Roasted twelve kilos at a time, every Tuesday
props.body:
Sarita started roasting in a popcorn pan in 2076. Today the beans come from two farmer cooperatives in Nuwakot and Gulmi, and we roast small batches so nothing sits on the shelf for more than a fortnight.

Ask at the counter and we will grind a 250 g bag for your filter, French press or moka pot.

props.heading: Opening hours
props.note: The kitchen closes at 20:30. We close on Dashain Tika and Laxmi Puja, and open late (10:00) on the day after.

props.title: Coming with more than six?
props.text: Call a day ahead and we will set the long table, and keep the momo coming.

pages.title: Visit
pages.seoTitle: Visit and book a table · Ghumti Café, Jhamsikhel
pages.seoDescription: Find us on Jhamsikhel Road near Sanepa Chowk. Book a table or the long table for groups; we confirm by phone.

props.heading: Book a table
props.text: Tell us the day, the time and how many of you. We confirm by phone within the hour, 8:00 to 20:00.
props.services:
Table for two
Table for four
The long table (6 to 12)
props.success: Thank you. We will call you to confirm the table.

props.heading: Find us
props.address: Jhamsikhel Road, near Sanepa Chowk, Lalitpur 44600. The green gate beside the pharmacy.

items.a: Two-wheeler parking at the front. Cars can park on the Sanepa side street after 17:00.

items.q: Can I work from the café?
items.a: Yes. Wi-Fi is free and laptops are welcome until noon on weekdays. After noon we keep the tables for lunch.

items.q: Do you take eSewa, Fonepay or cards?
items.a: eSewa and Fonepay for any amount, and cards above Rs 500.
Yes, in the garden seats at the back.

props.heading: Events and catering
props.text: Birthdays, office lunches, a momo counter at your wedding. Tell us the date and the number of guests.
props.success: Thank you. Sarita will write back within a day.
